requirements.text: Expertise in machine learning, ideally applied to medical or biological data
PhD or MSc in Physics, Biology or a related discipline
Proficiency in Python, writing clean, tested, version-controlled code
Working knowledge of Bash and Docker
Analyze spectroscopy data using signal processing and machine learning techniques
Experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn or PyTorch
Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Valid EU work permit, or already living in Berlin or willing to relocate there
Design experiments to answer relevant questions through data science
